headline: Gulf of Thailand record quarter; revenue doubles
summary_short: Record Q2 2026: production 22,309 bbl/d (+4% y/y), revenue $259.8M (~2x y/y) on realized price $105.8/bbl (+56%). FCF $104.7M; cash + working capital $321.7M, zero debt.
summary_long: Valeura Energy reported record Q2 2026 financial and operational results from its Gulf of Thailand oil fields (Jasmine, Manora, Nong Yao, Wassana). Working-interest production of 22,309 bbl/d (2.03M bbl total, +4% y/y). Revenue $259.8M — roughly double Q2 2025 — on realized price $105.8/bbl (+56% y/y). Adjusted EBITDAX $162.8M; adjusted operating cash flow $154.1M; free cash flow $104.7M. Operating costs $58.3M ($28.7/bbl). Balance sheet strengthened: cash $316.5M (incl. $15.8M restricted), no debt, adjusted net working capital $321.7M.
confidence_notes: Realized price uplift is primarily Brent-linked (Gulf of Thailand oil grades). All figures pre-royalty, per Valeura convention. Zero debt makes the free cash flow number effectively distributable.
